name: a clearance_discount note carries NO lines: it moves creditedPaise and no line's creditedBasePaise

expected.workings: A 20000 clearance discount closes the bill at 80000. The note carries no lines, so creditedPaise moves and creditedBasePaise does NOT -- the receivable shrank, the eligible SERVICE base did not, and the ratio between them is what the accrual base measures. eligibleBase = 100000 - 0 = 100000. settleable = 100000 - 20000 = 80000. collected = 80000 - 0 = 80000. targetBase = divHalfUp(100000 x 80000, 80000) = 100000. target = percentAmount(100000, 1000) = divHalfUp(100000000, 10000) = floor(200010000 / 20000) = 10000. delta = 10000. The partner earns on the whole service the hospital delivered, even though the hospital chose to collect less for it -- which is the asymmetry DD19's reader exists to preserve.
